definition.en: The Eight Core Sectors represent the most critical industrial segments that serve as the foundation for the Indian economy's infrastructure and manufacturing growth.
definition.hi: The Eight Core Sectors represent the most critical industrial segments that serve as the foundation for the Indian economy's infrastructure and manufacturing growth.

importanceInUpsc.en: These sectors are vital for UPSC GS-3 as they constitute approximately 40% of the Index of Industrial Production (IIP), serving as a key barometer for industrial performance. Understanding their interlinkages with the broader economy is essential for analyzing macroeconomic trends and policy impacts.
